mapper.select: SELECT c.clue_total, c.clue_wait_allot, c.clue_wait_follow, c.clue_following, c.clue_false, c.clue_convert_business, b.business_total, b.business_wait_allot, b.business_wait_follow, b.business_following, b.business_false, b.business_convert_customer FROM ( SELECT count(1) as clue_total, count(case when status = 1 then 1 end) as clue_wait_allot, count(case when status = 2 then 1 end) as clue_wait_follow, count(case when status = 3 then 1 end) as clue_following, count(case when status = 4 then 1 end) as clue_false, count(case when status = 5 then 1 end) as clue_convert_business FROM clue ) c CROSS JOIN ( SELECT count(1) as business_total, count(case when status = 1 then 1 end) as business_wait_allot, count(case when status = 2 then 1 end) as business_wait_follow, count(case when status = 3 then 1 end) as business_following, count(case when status = 4 then 1 end) as business_false, count(case when status = 5 then 1 end) as business_convert_customer FROM business ) b
